word.item: In the past days we had some diseases that did not have medicine.
Even it is still there up to now though medicine has been found now when people were suffering from disease like that let say like in a homested like this.
That we are sitted in it happens that people are suffering from whooping cough.
One way of preventing that disease from spreading to other homesteds they were taking a bunch of leaves and then they put at the gate.
Where that disease is there like that and then.
Those people should not leave there and other people that are visitors they should not enter there now these people were suffering that disease until when they will get healed.
They be buried and others don't get infected from a disease like whooping cough and another one again it was called ashihundu.
That disease did not have medicine.
So they were blocking like that so that it does not spread to other people they put a bunch of leaves on the road on the gate.
And then these people were just there like that and then things about beer or the beer that people were brewing.
In the past people were brewing beer in the past not that they want to get money eeh people were brewing beer.
Let's say like a girl wants to get married.
Now they will brew beer at that home and then they call people from the side of the girl.
And others from the side of the boy and then people drink beer they rejoice because they want to do a wedding or.
Other type of beer was brewed when boys were getting circumcised.
They were brewing beer eeeh so that.
To please themselves that they want to get a man in the village and then they brew beer so that.
That boy gets to be circumcised they were doing like that in the past.
When people had planted their things and then they get to harvesting and then they really harvest well.
Because they have gotten alot of food.
They rejoice together they call relatives and neighbors all of them they gather they say.
Now this year has been good.
We have harvested alot of food and then they brew beer now they place that beer in a pot.
And then elder men that were in the homested could put in the traditional straws they start to drink they were brewing beer that they call busaa.
That is what they were brewing and then they do those celebrations on them like that.
Or those events of celebrating that they have gotten a harvest that is good.
And then we had some other families.
Eeeh these days it is very hard for people to marry two wives or three but in the past days.
We find a man was at his home he used to marry his first wife.
Those days he was marrying not because the first wife has bored him.
Even this first wife was the one that was helping him to marry the second wife.
Now and then it happens that they build a house in the middle.
Of the land and then the houses of the other wives they will be.
Now that man will be going these women were the ones that were going to this house of the man they take in food if it is the duty of the elder wife to bring food today.
Again she will sleep in this house today again the second wife will do like that.
The following day or if they have agreed per week each of them to do like that to take care of.
This man there was not problem of food now these women their work was just to dig the farm.
They had kept even cows and goats and many sheep and then they plant many crops in the farm cassava potatoes bananas.
Now for the women work was just to give birth to many children and those children.
There were no schools they were not going to schools now the work for the children was to look after cows and the girls go to gather firewood.
As they cook food and the boys go to graze cows.
Now and then the days for digging they all gather in the farm and dig and then they harvest their food and put.
In the granary and life was just good those days and these days when you find someone has married the second wife you know now this elder one has bored him.
He has not married because he wants to just marry her for fun or they have agreed it is because they have disagreed with the elder one or the elder one has annoyed him.
He prefers to marry the second one to really annoy her I think.
That is how I used to hear in the past they have reached there.
Let me talk about some things that I have read here.
If she gave birth from home they were calling her shitwati.
Now a girl like that getting married was a problem.
It seems like when she wanted to get married.
They were looking for just an old man just and old man who even has his wife already.
They see since she has not taken good care of herself she has delivered children from home now this one.
Is not a good person so they were just searching for her an old man.
That is how the people in the past were doing but a girl who took good care of herself she has not given birth from home.
That girl they were doing for her a wedding they organize for a wedding they brew beer.
They prepare things different meals they even slaughter a cows.
So that people can celebrate her getting married but when you deliver a baby from home.
You were not getting married in a respectful way again they were searching for you.
An old man that you will get married to but these days they have changed.
Even girls they give birth from the house again you see they are doing wedding they get married now that one ends like that.
Now let us come to the women.
If she was in her house.
After she has given birth she was selected for meals that she is supposed to eat she was not just eating.
Every type of meal they were choosing for them the meals that they are supposed to eat and others they should not eat.
Until the day that she will want to give birth again when she will give birth like that, that day that she will give birth.
When she gives birth again there are meals that she is supposed to eat when she has given birth and she should not eat others for example.
Food like fish she is not supposed to eat fish.
They used to say when she eats the body.
Will be releasing skin they will come out she will not be okey again the boobs will be hurting the baby will not have something to drink.
And the vegetables that she is supposed to eat in plenty she is supposed to eat vegetables like murhere like inderema.
To take care of the child that she has given birth to and they were not giving birth from the hospital there were no hospitals they were just giving birth from home.
Now and that child when the child is given birth to he has.
A cord that is supposed to be cut so they were going to take lukhachu.
Lukhachu from millet that they were coming they cut the child's cord.
Now that child is taken she is cared for now they did not have razor blades.
I have passed there like that.
When you come to the care of the babies when someone was giving birth to her children girls to boys.
Eldest to the youngest these children were cared differently.
When an elder one was mature when he wants to build a house for example if it is a boy.
He was shown by the father that is his father where he is supposed to build.
They go and plant there a stick they tell him here is where you are supposed to build very far not near the house of the father they were taking him on quite a distance.
Now he builds there he stays far.
And they follow each other like that as they come to the last born now this last born is the one that they were saying he should live with the parents until when his parents die.
And then he will remain in the residence of the parents that is how they were treated again the girls.
Getting married the elder one was the one to begin.
The following one to get married.
Until up to the last one but these days you just find even the last child has gotten married while the elder one is still there.
Days are really changing things are not the same way they were.
But in the past it was a must if you are young you will not get married before your elder one gets married the elder one has to get married first.
Then the younger one follows again the boys like that in marriage.
Wives it happened that until when the elder marries a wife.
The followng one to marry a wife then the younger one but right now the person that is ready you just see the child has entered with the wife.
What you could have waited for someone to marry no I wait for him I don't know maybe he will not marry he stops you like that.
Now things have changed in these days and then we come to something.
People in the early days they did not have churches even before the bible came.
They had their way they knew we have God.
One that they pray to but there was no bible.
For that reason they were not even building churches but they had a specific place a place where they went to bow.
They had made a place that is a stone was like a place now that is where they were going and then they go and bow there they sing their songs.
And then they pray to their God that they believed in they go there like in the morning.
Very early before sunrise they go and pray there again in the evening when the sun is setting again they go back there they pray from there.
Again or they had like a tall tree that tree was not cut or they go there like that.
Some were doing like that they were going to the tree they go and pray from there and others wait when the sun is rising.
And then they look there where the sun is rising and then they pray on the sun and others those ones.
Where it is heading when it is going to set again they will turn and look there.
They pray on it that is their faith was telling them the God that they are praying to is in that sun like that.
That is how people were worshiping in the past and then when the bible came.
When the whiteman had brought that is when they began to build churches that you see them building these ones now they were going inside there.
That is when the whiteman brought the bible and then preach about Jesus Christ.
Now that is when you see people these days they go to churches.
They bow inside there they do no longer bow on stones on trees or on the sun not on the stone.
That is how people in the past were doing and then we come to witchcraft.
There was witchcraft in the past I do not know if these days it is still there but in the past the witchdoctors were very many.
Some were jumping outside here like this at night.
They were waking up they go outside here at night you hear when you are asleep someone is jumping outside as he really jumps.
He scoops even the soil outside he throws on your house.
People were bewitching like that now someone like that if they wanted to catch him.
They were leaving because these people were jumping outside as they hit on the road as they hit on the road so when they wanted to catch him.
They were just closing the door without locking so that when he will come to hit on the door when it opens and slides inside the house and they are ready with something like a log of fire.
When it slides inside the house because these people were jumping naked.
So when he will hit the door heavily when it gets inside the house and they pierce him with that log of fire now there.
They have given him the punishment.
They have beaten him a cane that he is supposed to leave those things that he is doing.
They are things that are not good now that person stops completely again he was not repeating.
I have passed there like that.
Now we hear in the past people had war they were going to war.
And for their war they were fighting.
They were grabbing the wealth that they have or the wealth that they have.
They grab or even the land they grab land from other people they chase them they leave there and go.
Or even grabbing even wives men go to war when a man fights.
And defeats the man that he was fighting with.
Now that one to give him his wife that is how they were doing in the past.
So they were going for example when you hear somewhere like Chavakali there when men were leaving as they go to war.
Women were going there to wait for them there in the evening to see whether these men will come back now if man.
Your man has not returned you just know ooh they have killed him there so a place where they call Chavakali there the name was gotten with the reason that.
Wives were leaving as they go to gather there to wait for their husbands when they have gone to war to fight so.
Yours when he returned you used to go with him home and if yours has not returned.
You know he has died there you just return home you go and mourn now.
That is how people were engaging in war they were fighting in things like that.
They go and fight they steal cows they fight and chase people where they are living there they take it to be their place.
Now and then we come to death.
It was not there the way it is right now.
You used to stay for many days that is when you will hear someone has died.
Now when you heard someone has died people were covering themselves.
They go there to that person who has died there they walk for a long distance they go there they go to live there.
And they were going there with food they go there and they are carrying things that they are going to eat there it is not like these days.
When people are coming to your home for funeral they are coming.
To eat that is you give them food they eat and in the past they were going with food and then they live there until when they will burry that dead person.
When they are mourning when they are singing songs.
Again when they have finished burrying they stay there for a month again is when they will get back to the home where they came from.
Again when they are going back like that they will stay for a long time is when they will hear another person has died where very far but right now.
Funeral has changed people are really dying they can even die in this house they die in this one you find another one is there.
In the same week now death has become a common thing among people a common thing those people.
They just take it normal sometimes if they hear someone has died they don't even go they just say no people that are there they will do what.
They are not taking it like the past days.
They go and gather there no again the food that they were carrying as they take when you find someone has carried food he has brought it to your funeral he is your relative.
But the way neighbors and other people were doing they bring food to the funeral you find it is full you do not cook you that are berieved.
These ones are different eeh when you are berieved.
Again you have to know the mourners that are coming there how they will eat that is how funeral was going these days.
And the way they were going in the past days now there is an issue of divorce.
A woman and a man in the house when they were living in the house.
Someone could not just leave her house easily she go.
Just like that until they check they know what is causing this woman to leave this house.
Or what is making this man to chase this wife they were really checking.
For even the clan to come it gather itself it seats and ask these people questions what is causing you to divorce.
And then they meet with this wife this wife maybe if she left without telling the clan that I am leaving this house when she got to her home.
If she explained to her parents I have left there that marriage has defeated me.
These and these she explains the difficulty that she had even her parents could not believe it they were just seeing that this girl the marriage has defeated her.
They go and prepare for her flour in a big can and then they go and cut meat in the butchery and then they get chicken and then they tell her go back to your home.
And then she returns to her home.
And then she goes and stays there and then it seems that someone has gotten used to her home.
In perserverence because it happened that even when she leaves there and goes to her home parents are still telling her.
Go back to your home go and take care of your children now things like prostitution were not really there the way they are currently there.
Someone they have not even wronged her in her house that she is in she has left she is saying I will go and look for work I will go to Nairobi.
I will go where when she goes to their home and just says that husband has done this to me they just tell he if he has done like that.
Sit here do not go back there now it seems families.
They have dispersed they do not have power again when you get issues in your house.
Clans the way they were sitting in the past they discuss no they say those ones are their issues in their house like that if they want to stay in if they want to divorce.
That is their problem now it seems unity has reduced in people these days than the past ones.
The past ones they could gather they come and see what you have gotten into.
Now that is why you see we have many families.
That we have one parent because this parent when she was unable to stay in her marriage she left with her children and went.
She rented a house on the market she is living their with children.
Because at her home when she goes there maybe her siblings are telling her here no and where she has left.
There ni and then it happens that she has to go and stay on the market place that is why you see many children are thrown.
They are just in here they are just walking they do not have their parents.
The unity that was there in the past days has reduced now it is not there and then we have children.
Or one parent is just raising children alone the father is not there or the mother is not there.
Now that is why you see the world has changed again in the past.
Eeeh for example a boy when he chases his wife.
You used to hear his parent becomes harsh she tells him you will just take care of your children if you have told that wife to go.
You yourself you will just take care of your children.
And then the boy checks and wonders how I'm I going to raise these babies until this wife gets back.
He waits maybe he works somewhere and then returns it seems.
The wife has left him with a small child until he has to take a route and follow up he goes and take his wife he pleads with her he tells her come.
You take care of the children we stop the issues that we were on but like today.
When you go to the side of boys you find the parent is telling him if the wife has defeated you let her go let her go I will just raise these children.
I myself will just raise them.
Now people become rude they become rude you do not have anything to tell me that is why you see the house are not stable the way I said you find children.
They do not have their parents.
They are just there maybe they have their grandmother or they do not even have a place to stay they are like that in these days.
I think they have reached there first start by pausing.
